rideDescriptions.r_001: Beat the traffic and greet the sun on a mellow loop through Kathmandu's quiet early-morning streets, finishing with tea at Ratna Park. A great starter ride for anyone new to group cycling.
rideDescriptions.r_002: A relaxed cultural ride through the medieval alleys and squares of Bhaktapur. We'll stop at Nyatapola Temple and Dattatreya Square for photos before looping back along the Hanumante River.
rideDescriptions.r_003: A demanding climb up to Nagarkot for sweeping Himalayan views. Expect steady gradients for the first 15km and a fast, technical descent back. Strong legs recommended.
rideDescriptions.r_004: An easygoing after-work spin around Lalitpur's ring road, wrapping up with coffee at Pulchowk. Lights required as we'll finish after dusk.
rideDescriptions.r_005: Singletrack, fire roads, and a punishing final ascent through the Godavari botanical hills. This is a proper mountain-bike test with technical descents.
rideDescriptions.r_006: Cool pine-forest air and gentle singletrack inside Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park. A great half-day escape from the city with a packed-lunch stop at the viewpoint.
rideDescriptions.r_007: A brutal but rewarding switchback climb to Chandragiri Hills. Cable car ticket included for anyone who wants to ride up and enjoy a scenic descent instead.
rideDescriptions.r_008: Rolling gravel roads east of the valley with far-reaching mountain views at sunrise. Mixed surfaces throughout, gravel or MTB tyres recommended.
rideDescriptions.r_009: A fun, low-key night ride through the lit-up streets of Thamel and around Kathmandu Durbar Square, wrapping up with momos for everyone.
rideDescriptions.r_010: A gentle historical circuit through the hilltop town of Kirtipur, taking in Chilancho Stupa and the old Newari courtyards, with a slow climb up to the viewpoint at the end.
rideDescriptions.r_011: A full lap of the Kathmandu Ring Road for those training for longer distances. Two rolling support stops along the way.
rideDescriptions.r_012: A friendly climb toward Budhanilkantha with a stop at the reclining Vishnu statue before rolling back downhill.
rideDescriptions.r_101: A classic 3-day teahouse trek through rhododendron forests to the Poon Hill viewpoint for a 360° sunrise over the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges.
rideDescriptions.r_102: A 4-day off-the-beaten-path trek through forest and ridge trails to Mardi Himal Base Camp, with close-up views of Machapuchare.
rideDescriptions.r_103: A 7-day Himalayan trek through the Langtang valley, Tamang villages, and glacial moraines just north of Kathmandu.
rideDescriptions.r_104: A 2-day ridge trek from Chisapani to Nagarkot along the rim of the Kathmandu valley, with wide Himalayan views at sunrise.
rideDescriptions.r_105: A steep climb to Phulchowki, the highest hill rim of the Kathmandu valley, through birding trails and dense forest.
rideDescriptions.r_106: A shaded, easy loop through Nagarjun Forest Reserve up to the Jamacho viewpoint, popular with birdwatchers and families.
rideDescriptions.r_107: A rewarding day hike along the Bagmati source, climbing through Shivapuri National Park to the Chisapani ridge.
rideDescriptions.r_108: A gentle, family-friendly hike up Champadevi hill with a picnic stop and views over the whole Kathmandu valley.
rideDescriptions.r_109: An evening motorbike cruise up to Nagarkot for city lights and a late dinner, back down before midnight.
rideDescriptions.r_110: A full-day highway run to Chitwan for lunch by the Narayani river before heading back to the valley.
rideDescriptions.r_111: A technical off-road ride through the fire roads of Shivapuri National Park for dual-sport and adventure bikes.
rideDescriptions.r_112: A 3-day overland motorbike expedition to Upper Mustang's high-desert landscapes and Buddhist monasteries.

bios.me: Weekend warrior chasing sunrise rides around the valley. Always up for a hill climb and a good cup of coffee after.
bios.aarav: Organizing sunrise and heritage rides across the valley for six years. Believer in slow mornings and steady climbs.
bios.priya: Cultural-loop specialist. If there is a temple on the route, I am leading it.
bios.bibek: Night owl on two wheels. You will usually find me out after sunset.
bios.anita: Trail dog. Pine forests, singletrack, and a thermos of tea at the top.
bios.suresh: Climbing specialist. Nagarkot is basically my backyard at this point.
bios.kabita: Evening spins, good playlists, and even better company.
bios.nischal: Switchbacks and suffering, then a cable car ride down. Chandragiri regular.
bios.roshani: Gravel over everything. Give me rolling hills and a sunrise.
bios.dipesh: Mountain bike or nothing. Godavari trails are my playground.
bios.sabina: Slow historical circuits are underrated. Kirtipur every Sunday.

posts.p_001: Finally cracked 50km/h on the Nagarkot descent this morning. Legs are jelly but absolutely worth the sunrise view from the top. 🚵‍♂️
posts.p_002: Yesterday's Bhaktapur heritage loop was pure magic — golden light on the temple roofs and a perfectly quiet Durbar Square before the crowds arrived.
posts.p_003: PSA: new singletrack has opened up near Godavari — flowy, fast, and a real test on the climbs. Bringing the group there next month.
posts.p_004: Small win: talked three coworkers into joining their first evening spin around Lalitpur. Watching people fall in love with cycling never gets old.
posts.p_005: Gravel bike finally set up with wider tyres for the Dhulikhel route. Who's in for a sunrise test ride this weekend?
posts.p_006: Hit 200km for the month! Slowly building up toward my first century ride. Thanks to everyone who's been pacing me on the ring road loops.

messages.m_001: Hey! Are you in for the Kathmandu Sunrise Ride this Saturday?
messages.m_002: Yes, count me in. What time should I be there?
messages.m_003: We're meeting at Ratna Park at 5:30am, before the traffic picks up.
messages.m_004: Bring lights just in case, and a light jacket, it's chilly that early.
messages.m_005: Perfect, I'll be there. Thanks for organizing!
messages.m_006: Great, see you at Ratna Park at 5:30 sharp!
messages.m_010: The Nagarkot descent has some loose gravel patches this week.
messages.m_011: Good to know, I'll take it easy on the way down.
messages.m_012: Bring a spare tube, the descent is rough this season.
messages.m_020: Loved the photos from Sunday's ride!
messages.m_030: Are you joining the Shivapuri trail next weekend?
messages.m_040: Thanks for leading the spin yesterday 🙌
